The deployer seeds Lagoon Hostel (demo) onto the verified list
The deployer hands the verified list to the school-list council, a Sputnik DAO (purposesplit-council.sputnik-v2.testnet)
From now on only a council vote can change the list
steps.verdict: Checked: get_config says the list is held by purposesplit-council.sputnik-v2.testnet

steps.title: Cheat: the deployer tries to add a payee after handing the list over
steps.verdict: Refused: "Only the registry DAO can change the verified list"

steps.title: Cheat: Tolu tries to put his own lookalike account on the list
steps.verdict: Refused: "Only the registry DAO can change the verified list"

steps.title: A councillor proposes adding Unity Hall Caterers, with a link to where it publishes its account
The first councillor votes yes
Two yes votes are needed: the proposal waits for the second councillor, a real person
steps.verdict: Checked: proposal 0 on purposesplit-council.sputnik-v2.testnet is waiting for chrysolitee.testnet to vote; Unity Hall is not on the list yet

steps.title: Mum creates a pot for Tolu's fees: 300 fees + 50 pocket money, payable only to the school
Mum adds 200 for fees
Mum adds 50 pocket money, which goes straight to Tolu
Uncle Femi adds 100 for fees
The school sends Tolu's bill: 280 for the session
Cheat: Tolu sends himself a bill
steps.verdict: Refused: "Only llu.purposesplit.testnet can ask this pot for payment"

steps.title: Cheat: Tolu sends the fees to himself
steps.verdict: Refused: "This money cannot go to tolu.purposesplit.testnet. This pot pays only llu.purposesplit.testnet."

steps.title: Cheat: Tolu pays a lookalike "school" he made, llu-bursary
steps.verdict: Refused: "llu-bursary.purposesplit.testnet is not on the verified list. This pot pays only llu.purposesplit.testnet."

steps.title: Cheat: Tolu pays a different real school
Cheat: Mum tries to take the fees back early
steps.verdict: Refused: "Only tolu.purposesplit.testnet can pay from this pot."

steps.title: Cheat: Tolu pays the school less than it billed, to keep the rest in play
steps.verdict: Refused: "llu.purposesplit.testnet has not asked for 150 tUSD. Money leaves this pot only against a payment request from the payee."

steps.title: Tolu pays the school's bill of 280, with his matric number attached
Cheat: Tolu confirms the payment himself, to get a "Fees paid" pass without the school
steps.verdict: Refused: "Only the payee that was paid can confirm a payment"

steps.title: The school confirms the payment on-chain
Tolu now holds a pass that anyone can check
steps.verdict: Checked: "Fees paid: Lagos Lagoon University (demo)", pass 0-0, held by tolu.purposesplit.testnet

steps.title: Cheat: Tolu tries to give his pass to a friend
steps.verdict: Refused: "A pass cannot be moved or sold. It stays with the account that paid, as proof."

steps.title: Cheat: Tolu tries to pay out more than is left
steps.verdict: Refused: "Only 20 tUSD is left in this pot."

resident1 adds 40
resident2 adds 40

The first neighbour votes yes
A second neighbour votes yes
The vote passes, and the money box refuses to carry it out
steps.verdict: Refused: "Nothing can be paid until the target is reached: 120 of 200 tUSD raised so far."

steps.title: resident4 adds 40
resident5 adds 40

steps.verdict: Refused: "Only a vote of adeyemi-street.sputnik-v2.testnet can release this pot."

The first neighbour votes yes
A second neighbour votes yes

The first neighbour votes yes
A second neighbour votes yes
The vote passes, and the money box refuses to carry it out

steps.title: a neighbour proposes a street vote to pay Sparks Electrical's request for parts: 100
The first neighbour votes yes
A second neighbour votes yes
The third yes vote passes it, and the DAO pays from the street's box
Sparks Electrical confirms the 100 arrived
The light is back: Sparks Electrical asks for the remaining 80
a neighbour proposes a street vote to pay Sparks Electrical's 80 for labour
The first neighbour votes yes
A second neighbour votes yes
The third yes vote passes it, and the DAO pays from the street's box
Sparks Electrical confirms the 80 arrived
The street holds proof of both stages it paid for
Cheat: a resident asks for a refund before the deadline
steps.verdict: Refused: "Money goes back only after the deadline, or at once if the payees leave the verified list. Until then it is kept for its purpose."

steps.title: Emeka opens an appeal for his mother's surgery: 500, payable only to the hospital or the pharmacy, plus 80 for food and transport sent straight to the family
resident1 gives 100 from a link shared on X
resident2 gives 100 from a link shared on X
resident3 gives 100 from a link shared on X
The hospital sends its bill: 380 for the operation
Cheat: Emeka pays the hospital before the 500 target is reached
steps.verdict: Refused: "Nothing can be paid until the target is reached: 300 of 500 tUSD raised so far."

steps.title: resident4 gives 100
resident5 gives 100
resident1 also gives 80 for food and transport, which goes straight to the family
Cheat: Emeka sends the donations to his own account
steps.verdict: Refused: "This money cannot go to emeka.purposesplit.testnet. This pot pays only lagoonheights.purposesplit.testnet or cornercare.purposesplit.testnet."

steps.title: Cheat: Emeka sends the surgery money to the family's account instead
steps.verdict: Refused: "This money cannot go to ngozi-family.purposesplit.testnet. This pot pays only lagoonheights.purposesplit.testnet or cornercare.purposesplit.testnet."

steps.title: Cheat: Emeka pays the hospital's bill to the pharmacy
steps.verdict: Refused: "cornercare.purposesplit.testnet has not asked for 380 tUSD. Money leaves this pot only against a payment request from the payee."

steps.title: Emeka pays the hospital's bill of 380
The hospital confirms the payment on-chain
The pharmacy sends its bill: 70 for medicine
Emeka pays the pharmacy's bill of 70
The pharmacy confirms the payment on-chain
Emeka holds proof for every giver to see: both bills were paid and confirmed
steps.verdict: Checked: "Hospital bill paid: Lagoon Heights Hospital (demo)" (2-0), "Paid: Corner Care Pharmacy (demo)" (2-1)
